method: Read the five complete current source files, follow their declared source/evidence paths and failure transitions, and compare their SHA256 hashes before and after review. No native module was imported or executed.

prior_findings.check: Requires scientific EXECUTION119D status and source, external exit zero and source, reporter R119D_REPORTER_EXECUTION status passed, absence of FAILED_REPORT119D, unique and complete top-level reporter output manifest, and every declared reporter output size/SHA256 before archive construction.

Requires a full lowercase 40-character commit, resolves it as an actual Git commit, matches the input-manifest author commit, enumerates the committed native revision tree, checks regular-file Git modes, verifies each author-source member by Git blob hash and local SHA256, and requires complete source-tree membership. Non-tree publication derivatives are explicitly designated. All four PDFs and SOURCE_PDF_MANIFEST119/PUBLICATION119 are required with matching author commit and PDF size/hash bindings.

A command entry with actual argv and start time is saved before launch. Exit status or exception type/message is recorded, and finally records completion time, elapsed seconds and any surviving log hash. The package validator also writes a failed top-level status from its outer exception handler.

additional_reviews.finding: No additional material defect identified. Container construction is exclusive; member identities, duplicate membership, safe relative paths, regular-file type, exact sizes and content hashes are checked on readback. Part lengths/SHA256, ordered reassembly length and complete archive SHA256 are checked.

No additional material defect identified. Extraction checks resolved destination containment and refuses conflicting existing files; new files use exclusive creation. The validator requires a fresh output directory, extracts current plus D evidence into its own replay root, and moves only extracted A/B/C receipt copies to a separate preserved path before fresh record-audit outputs.

D saved-record replay receives the actual revision and repository for immutable source binding and the isolated replay root for primary inputs, external launcher records and D traces. Exact fixture reuse and proof algebra have separate fresh output paths and are explicitly distinguished from campaign/timing/983-policy reexecution.

Four native documents are compiled under the fixed source epoch with dated build receipts; declared source hashes, graphics, actual TeX recorder input closure, generated auxiliary inputs, final PDF hashes and diagnostics are recorded separately. The strict path exits unsuccessfully for reported overfull/undefined-reference/citation issues or the named integration placeholders.

Workflow targets the isolated revision, uses pinned action commits and declared Python/dependencies, retains complete commit history for immutable-source references, grants contents read, runs validation then strict four-document compilation, and uploads actual receipt/log/PDF paths under an always condition. The workflow does not call the main A/B/C campaigns or the full D solver. No material path mismatch or overwrite blocker was found in the declared route.

limits: This is a source review of the exact five hashes, not proof of an executed package verification, a successful ZIP build/upload, remote CI success, an exhaustive security assessment, or a new scientific validation. Final publication/source manifests and the actual container receipt must identify the committed tree and real output bytes when those operations finish.
